scope: Twelve original deterministic task smoke tests, six short and six with96 distractor records; not a broad held-out benchmark. Frozen before padded-model results.
generation: Greedy, thinking disabled, max64 tokens; decode both arms and score normalized exact answers. Preserve outputs even when baseline fails.
teacher_forcing: Score expected-answer token NLL from each arm after its own prompt prefill; compare per-case and aggregate, without inventing equality requirements.
acceptance: Report all per-case pass/fail and baseline-to-candidate regressions. Any observed task regression needs investigation before enabling. No tuning the fixture or dropping failed cases.
quality_limit: A pass cannot establish unchanged general quality; numerical drift and this smoke screen remain explicit limitations.
normalization: Trim surrounding whitespace/code delimiters; parse Python literals and compare values; Yes/No case-insensitive; other text exact. Require EOS before64-token cap.
